text: Security is a crucial part of web development that every developer should take seriously. First, websites should always use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server, protecting sensitive information from attackers. Second, strong authentication systems help ensure that only authorized users can access protected areas. Third, developers must validate all user input to prevent common vulnerabilities such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting. Unfortunately, many websites still suffer from these basic security flaws, which can lead to data breaches and loss of user trust. By following secure coding practices and staying informed about common vulnerabilities, developers can build safer and more reliable web applications.
